class.name: MaszynaTrianglesSink
class.brief_description: Where a scenery's [code]triangles[/code] nodes go as they are parsed.
class.description: Merges the triangles as they are added, as the original merges its shapes ([code]basic_section::insert()[/code], scene.cpp:846-863), so the raw triangles of every include are never kept: a large opaque shape is cut along the 1 km grid into its section's chunk of its texture, its range dropped; a translucent one, one with a range of at most 300 m or a minimum range goes whole into the chunk of its texture and range in its 250 m cell, merged there with a group whose centre is closer than 25 m ([MaszynaTrianglesChunkGeometry]). A sink with a directory keeps at most [constant BUDGET_BYTES] of geometry in memory and writes its largest chunks to the directory past that; [method finish] puts each section's chunks together in one [MaszynaTrianglesSector] file there. A sink without one keeps everything in memory. Thread-safe.

method.name: add_geometry
method.description: Appends a whole chunk's geometry to the chunk of its texture, cell and range.

method.name: add_geometry_file
method.description: [method add_geometry] of every chunk of the sector file at [param path] another sink finished - read, added and let go of.

method.name: add_triangles
method.description: Adds triangles in world space, three vertices each, cut into the cells they cover.

method.name: cell_get_origin
method.description: The centre of a section of the 1 km grid, which its chunk's positions are relative to.

method.name: create
method.description: A sink writing to [param directory], which is emptied first; an empty one keeps everything in memory. [param translucency] ([code](texture: String) -> bool[/code], [code]MaszynaMaterialManager.is_material_translucent[/code]) says whether a texture's shapes are translucent; it is called on the parse's workers, once per texture.

method.name: finish
method.description: Writes every section's chunks to one file, [code]<directory>/<x>_<z>.res[/code] ([MaszynaTrianglesSector]), and empties the sink. Returns a [Dictionary] per chunk: [code]path[/code] (its section's file), [code]index[/code] (in the file), [code]position[/code] (its origin), [code]texture[/code], [code]range_min[/code], [code]range_max[/code].

method.name: get_geometries
method.description: The chunks kept in memory, in the order they first appeared.

method.name: shape_is_ranged
method.description: Whether the original keeps such a shape in a 250 m cell and draws it by its range - translucent, a range of at most 300 m, or a minimum range ([code]basic_section::insert()[/code], scene.cpp:849-851) - rather than in its section, drawn whatever its range.

constants.constant: Geometry kept in memory by a sink with a directory before its largest chunks go to disk.
